seoTitle: Intrastat Threshold Checker With Your Limits
metaDescription: Compare yearly intra-EU arrivals and dispatches with the Intrastat thresholds you enter and see headroom or excess.
intro: Checks your trade totals against thresholds that you provide.
why:
Intrastat reporting applies when intra-EU goods trade passes a national threshold, separately for arrivals and dispatches. Thresholds differ by country and change.

Enter your totals and the thresholds from your statistics office. The tool flags the flows over the limit for review.

faq.a: No. They change and differ by country.

faq.q: Is it related to VAT filings?
faq.a: It is separate from the VAT EC Sales List.
